events.text: Lion dance troupes compete in the streets for the merchants' red envelopes hung high on poles.

effects.log: Two fighters in one lion, moving as one beast.
They reach the envelope. The crowd goes wild.

events.text: A lion dancer falls from the poles. The troupe needs a replacement for the tail.

ok.log: Your lion takes the prize. The troupe adopts you.

fail.log: You fall off the pole. The crowd loves it anyway.

effects.log: A broken arm, set straight.

events.text: Two lion dance troupes are also rival martial schools. Their lions start to fight.

fail.log: A lion head hits you in the face.

effects.log: It is the best lion dance of the year.

events.text: The lion dance drummer's arms give out. The troupe needs someone to drum.

effects.log: Your arms burn. The lion dances to your rhythm.

choices.text: Clap the rhythm for the crowd

effects.log: A thousand hands keep the beat.

events.text: The lion dances into a sick man's house to bring luck.

effects.log: The sick man laughs for the first time in weeks.
Lion dances bless the poor for free this year. (−3 taels)

events.text: A great dragon dance winds through the city, forty dancers long.

effects.log: You become one scale of a dragon. It feels wonderful.
A river of red and gold.

events.text: An old lion dance master says lion dance is the oldest martial art.

effects.log: Horse stance, jumps, and a lot of shouting.
'Because a lion must fight to eat, and dance to live.'

events.text: A troupe's winnings are stolen from their cart.

ok.log: A rival troupe's boy. The money goes back.

effects.log: The crowd refills their chest.

events.text: You make a lion head out of a basket and paper.

effects.log: Everyone gives you a red envelope. (+2 taels)
The chickens do not appreciate art.

events.text: A workshop where old craftsmen build lion heads from bamboo and paper.

effects.log: Your lion has a slightly surprised face.
Eyes are painted last, they say, to bring the lion to life.

events.text: The next town challenges yours to a lion dance contest.

effects.log: Weeks of practice. You come second.
Your lion wins "most fierce".

events.text: The lion dances end. The streets are covered in red paper.

effects.log: The last job of the new year.

choices.text: Keep a piece of firecracker paper for luck

effects.log: In your pocket all year.
